name: Sky Ladder
design_intent: TUTORIAL 3 of 4. Lesson: COMBINE — fly up first, THEN super for the peak. The goal ring is 3600px above the floor, chosen so NEITHER verb alone reaches it but the combo clears with margin: plain-boost ceiling = 760 px/s x 3.5s tank ~= 2660px < 3600 (tank dies 1000px short); super-only from the floor = 2800^2/3200 = 2450px < 3600 (1150px short); the COMBO — boost-climb ~1200px (~45 fuel), then fire the super while still rising (vy -760 + 2800 clamps to max_speed 3000 => apex 3000^2/3200 = 2812px above the fire point) — tops out around 1200+2812 = 4000px > 3600 with ~400px margin, and even a lazy hover-then-fire at 1200px still reaches 1200+2450 = 3650. The floor is SPRING tier (480 apex — the bounciest, so retry refuels bank fast at +20/touch and the course feels like a launchpad). Wide bumper rails mark the flight column visually. No void — a failed attempt is a long soft fall back to the spring floor.
hint: FLY HIGH FIRST — THEN  X / K  FOR THE PEAK
